scope: method rules only; no reader-facing claims

premises: Chart contains profile-versioned facts for Mệnh and Thân
Chart contains profile-versioned facts for Thiên Di, Tài Bạch and Quan Lộc
All referenced palace-state and relation terms resolve in an approved vocabulary
conditions: Evaluate Di–Tài–Quan as a related context after Mệnh–Thân
Preserve every applicable supported/adverse relation instead of flattening it into a score
exclusions: Do not add Nô Bộc to this relation from current evidence
Do not emit a behavior, ability, occupation, event or outcome claim
Do not treat the historical gendered passage as universal evidence
exceptions: Missing palace facts, relation geometry or state vocabulary produces rejected-insufficient-evidence
rules.conflictHandling: Record all admitted relations and defer; this rule supplies no winner or numeric weight.
rules.output: inference trace containing evaluated/missing fact groups only
blockers: Profile and cross-palace vocabulary are not approved
Tam phương/tứ chính geometry and relation predicates are not versioned

premises: Mệnh principal-star presence and state are explicit facts
Applicable cross-palace relations and their source-backed state classifications are explicit
Signal provenance and profile versions match
conditions: A direct favorable symbol does not bypass adverse cross-palace context
An empty or mixed Mệnh requires Tài–Quan and admitted aspect context
Preserve both supporting and opposing signals in the inference trace
exclusions: Do not infer an opposite-palace star that is absent from chart facts
Do not count stars or use an invented majority threshold
Do not resolve mixed signals into a reader-facing conclusion
exceptions: Undefined favorable/adverse state or relation predicate produces rejected-insufficient-vocabulary
Unresolved mixed signals produce deferred-conflict, not a synthetic midpoint
rules.conflictHandling: Fail closed while emitting accepted, rejected and conflicting signal references in the trace.
rules.output: admission/defer/reject decision for downstream reasoning; never a reading claim
blockers: State and constraint vocabulary is not approved

explicitGaps.requiredEvidence: A lawfully accessible, bibliographically identified source family with page-level passages for the same method.
Versioned definitions and calculation predicates for palace state, tam phương/tứ chính, đối/hợp chiếu and conflict relations.
A passage explicitly defining a Mệnh–Quan Lộc–Nô Bộc career relationship with conditions and exceptions. No such passage was found.
